content_sections.heading: About S-VYASA
content_sections.text: Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (S-VYASA) is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and its letterhead describes it as a NAAC Grade A+ accredited university. The vacancy notification is issued from Jigani, Bengaluru-560105, and is signed by the Registrar. The letterhead lists three addresses: the Registered address at #19, Eknath Bhavan, Gavipuram Circle, Kempegowda Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560004 (080-2661 2669, +91 7022024777); the Prashanti Campus at Prashanti Kutiram, Vivekananda Road, Kallubalu Post, Jigani, Anekal, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560105 (080-2263 9968, +91 7676749929); and the City Campus at Sattva Global City, Mysore Road, Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560059 (080-2990 0083, +91 9070907066). The general contact emails printed are [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.text: Applications go by email only. The notice states: "Interested candidates can apply by sending their detailed Resume to [email protected] before 5/12/2026." Email address: [email protected] What to send: a detailed Resume Deadline: before 5 December 2026 The notice does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: S-VYASA has 03 positions of Senior Assistant – Accounts & Finance. The notice lists the following qualifications for the post: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) / Master of Commerce (M.Com) / Masters in Business Administration (MBA) – Finance Working knowledge of accounting principles and statutory requirements Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software such as Tally, or similar systems Pay: Emoluments will be as per the institutional norms. No pay amount or pay level is printed. The age limit and the required years of experience are not specified in the notice. Candidates can check the official notification for the complete eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: S-VYASA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: As per the notice, the Senior Assistant – Accounts & Finance will be responsible for supporting day-to-day accounting and financial operations, maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, assisting with reconciliations, and supporting statutory compliance and reporting activities. The key responsibilities are: Maintain accurate books of accounts and financial records. Record and verify invoices, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable activities. Prepare bank, vendor, customer, and general ledger reconciliations. Prepare MIS reports and other financial statements as required. Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and follow up for timely settlements. Assist with GST, TDS, income tax, and other statutory compliance activities. Verify supporting documents and ensure compliance with internal financial controls. Maintain proper filing and documentation of accounting records. Support the reporting authorities in day-to-day accounting and administrative activities. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of financial information. Reconciliation of stock, inventories etc. Cash counter handling.
